steps.en: Set the tracker credential in your environment
steps.zh: 在环境变量里配好跟踪器凭证

steps.en: Copy WORKFLOW.md into your repo — front matter config, body prompt
steps.zh: 把 WORKFLOW.md 拷进仓库：头部配置，正文提示词

steps.en: Start the orchestrator pointed at the workflow file
steps.zh: 指向工作流文件，启动编排器

steps.en: Claims a ready issue and gives it an isolated git workspace
steps.zh: 认领就绪的 issue，为它建一个隔离的 git 工作区

steps.en: Works the issue with Codex in the workspace, reconciling tracker state each turn
steps.zh: 在工作区里驱动 Codex 干活，每轮后回写跟踪器状态

value.en: Manage work on the board — agents deliver PRs with proof of work while nobody babysits a run
value.zh: 在面板上管理工作即可——agent 交付带证据的 PR，没人需要盯着单次运行

README.md main @ 2026-09: 'Symphony monitors a Linear board for work and spawns agents... The agents complete the tasks and provide proof of work... land the PR'
